source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.5 in the book's order (PDF 236-238), with Examples 10.4 and 10.5 and a self-check.

blocks.text: Velocity selector aisa device (auzaar) hai jo charged particle ki velocity maloom karne ke liye istemal hota hai. Is mein chalte particle par electric aur magnetic forces is tarah lagai jati hain ke woh sirf ek hi velocity par ek doosre ko barabar (balance) karti hain; us velocity wala particle constant (na badalne wali) velocity se seedha chalta rehta hai.

Ek particle lein jis par positive charge +q hai aur jo velocity v se uniform magnetic field B mein, field ke perpendicular, dakhil hota hai. Us par magnetic force oopar ki taraf lagti hai (Fig. 10.11). Is force ko barabar karne ke liye particle par neeche ki taraf electric force lagni chahiye.

blocks.alt: Neele cross: B kaghaz ke andar. Positive charge +q velocity v se daen taraf chal raha hai; us par magnetic force F_B seedhi oopar hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.11: Kaghaz ke andar wali field ke perpendicular (90° par khara) chalte positive charge par magnetic force F_B (kitab ki Figure 10.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Velocity selector mein ek cylinder-numa tube hoti hai jo magnetic field B ke andar rakhi hoti hai. Tube ke andar parallel plate capacitor (do parallel plates) hota hai jo uniform electric field E banata hai. E, B ke perpendicular hai (Fig. 10.12).

blocks.alt: Neele cross ki qataron (B kaghaz ke andar) ke darmiyan tube mein oopar + plate aur neeche - plate hai; magenta electric field ke teer + se - ki taraf neeche hain. Charge +q baen se seedhi dashed line par dakhil hota hai; charge se ek teer neeche ki taraf hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.12: Velocity selector: magnetic field mein tube ke andar parallel plate capacitor (kitab ki Figure 10.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: E ke teer neeche hain, is liye +q par electric force qE neeche lagti hai (charge ke neeche wala teer). Magnetic force qvB, Fig. 10.11 ki tarah, oopar lagti hai. Jab qE = qvB, yaani v = E/B, to dono barabar ho kar khatam ho jati hain aur charge seedha nikal jata hai.

Jab positive particle tube ke baen sire se dakhil hota hai to magnetic force oopar aur electric force neeche, E ki direction (rukh) mein, lagti hai. Agar electric aur magnetic fields ki strength (zor) theek rakhi jaye to dono forces ek doosre ko khatam kar deti hain. Kul (net) force zero ho to Newton ke pehle law (qaida) ke mutabiq velocity v constant rehti hai, aur particle seedhi line mein chal kar tube ke daen sire se nikal jata hai.
Jin particles ki velocity v se different (alag) ho, woh mud jate hain aur daen sire se nahi nikalte.
Selected (chuni hui) velocity ki amount (kitna) yun nikalti hai.
Velocity v, B aur E dono ke perpendicular hai, is liye:
Particle na mude, is ke liye dono barabar hon:
ya (q dono taraf se kat jata hai)

blocks.title: Example 10.4
blocks.problem: 1000 m s⁻¹ se 2000 m s⁻¹ tak speed wale alpha particles aise velocity selector mein dakhil hote hain jahan electric intensity 300 V m⁻¹ aur magnetic induction 0.20 T hai. Kaun se particles bina mude (undeviated) guzrenge?
steps: Sirf woh particles guzrenge jin par electric force qE, magnetic force Bqv ke barabar ho (Fig. 10.12):
v = E/B = 300 N C⁻¹/0.20 N A⁻¹ m⁻¹ = 1500 m s⁻¹
blocks.answer: 1500 m s⁻¹ speed wale alpha particles bina mude guzrenge; baqi mud jayenge.

blocks.title: Point to ponder
blocks.text: Magnetic field mein chalte charged particle par force lagti hai. Use kis direction mein chalna chahiye ke us par force na lage? (Ishara: F = qvB sinθ mein θ = 0 rakh kar dekhein.)

blocks.title: Example 10.5
blocks.problem: Ek charged particle velocity selector se constant velocity par seedhi line mein guzarta hai. Selector ki electric field 4.8 × 10³ N C⁻¹ aur magnetic field 0.2 T hai. Electric field band karne par particle 3.0 cm radius ke gol raste par chalta hai. Particle ka charge to mass ratio (q/m) nikalein. (Kitab mein 'filed' chhapa hai, matlab field.)
steps: Particle E aur B dono ke perpendicular chal raha hai aur mudta nahi, is liye:
Electric field band hone par sirf magnetic force bachti hai, jo centripetal force ka kaam karti hai aur particle radius r ke circle (gol chakkar) mein chalta hai:
Values: E = 4.8 × 10³ N C⁻¹, B = 0.2 T, r = 3.0 cm = 3 × 10⁻² m

blocks.prompt: Velocity selector kya hai? Is ka kaam clear kijiye (comprehensive question 10.5). Ek particle 4.96 × 10⁴ m s⁻¹ se B = 0.114 T wale selector se bina mude guzarta hai; kitni electric field chahiye (numerical 10.11; kitab mein number 7.11 chhapa hai)?
blocks.explanation: Velocity selector mein uniform electric field aur uniform magnetic field ek doosre aur particle ki direction ke perpendicular hoti hain. Chalte charge par electric force qE aur magnetic force Bqv ulti directions mein hain aur sirf v = E/B par barabar hoti hain; is liye sirf isi speed ke particles seedhe guzarte hain, tez ya dheeme mud jate hain. E = vB = 4.96 × 10⁴ × 0.114 = 5.65 × 10³ N C⁻¹.

items: Velocity selector: perpendicular E (capacitor plates) aur B; +q par magnetic force Bqv oopar, electric force qE neeche; sirf v = E/B (10.15) par barabar, woh particle seedha nikalta hai (Newton ka pehla law), baqi mud jate hain.
Example 10.4: 1500 m s⁻¹ wale guzarte hain. Example 10.5: q/m = E/B²r = 4 × 10⁶ C kg⁻¹.
